My question with regards to the Adab of Mosque/ Mussalah. We have a small mussalah in our suburb. At our mussalah, the work of dawah is going very well. We are trying to participate in five amal. During the talim, we see that some of the brothers who joined the jamat late, they are still praying their fardth salat. And also, some brothers are praying their sunnah. what should we do? do we need to wait for those brothers? or start the talim immediately after the salat? Does this act effact salat of the other muslim brothers? Whether we become sinners or not? Same problem arises, when make "allan" for jula or Gasth. These kind of questions are killing for years. Personally, I have realised this problem. Because, sometimes I catch the jamat little late. Before finishing my salat, "allan'' or "talim" starts. Then it become to hard to concentrate on the salat. Sometimes, I can not join the talim because I have to go to my jobs. Therefore, I have to pray sunnah quickly. As the place is not too big, i can hear the sound. Sometimes loose my concentration in my rest of the salat. Plz help me out. Give any reference of hadith or quran regarding this. 3325 views Q. Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu !, 1. So my studies were affected by this atitude.wht does islam say abt this act of irresponsibilty and nt caring for the money sent to me by my parents. Any punishment for thir irresponsible person. Question: Aslam o alaikum. I am a student in medical college.Thr is a problem with me tht i m irresponsible.i belong to a rich family so i did nt care before from where the money was comin and which way i wasting . So my studies were affected by this atitude.wht does islam say abt this act of irresponsibilty and nt caring for the money sent to me by my parents. Any punishment for thir irresponsible person. If i think to run my family and fulfilling thr rights is it against tawkul or yaqeen. I m asking this cuz my life changed due to tableegh.then i was offering my prayers and going in the way of Allah but i was weaker towards my studies,no interest.later when i consulted psychotherapist he said it is because of irresponsible attitude towards future,ur duties.plz answer my question in detail so i can act more responsible and keep balance b/w deen and duniya. Answer ID: 8390 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1940/1806=D/1429) How did you come to know that you are irresponsible? You should also have indicated what kinds of irresponsibility you have committed. You can manage the household with piety and firm belief, rather you can also run the family in a better way while believing in Allah Almighty and with the blessing of piety. Because of fearing Allah, you can discharge well the rights and duties of the people. So, you should keep carrying out the Islamic acts along with studying Islamic books such as Behishti Zewar, Taleemuddin, Hayatus-Sahaba, and keep going to Jama?ah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
